player_prompt.intro:
As-salamu alaykum i Tilleɣa n Yefren!

A kewey teddaɣ 'P' ɣef tedwalt.
Tidwal:
  ' ' = Tajjalt (iɣewwaɣ aɣewwad)
  'H' = Ahay (t-ɛeqqel ḍart aɣreɣ)
  'G' = Azɣar (aweḍ ɣer daɣ aɣewwad)
  'P' = Iɣewwaɣ n wakud nnek

Aɣewwaɣ inaɣlanen: sufell, wadda, ayfus, ayfru (neɣ w, a, s, d)
Tira aɣewwaɣ-nnek am: [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d]

Azɣar: Ssufɣed seg tazwara (deg ufella-ayfus) ɣer azɣar (deg wadda-ayfru) war t-ɛeqqel ɣer kullu ahay!
